ABOUT.TITLE: About Kafar Banin
ABOUT.SUBTITLE: History, Nature, and a Vibrant Community
ABOUT.INTRO: Kafar Banin is a Lebanese village in the Dannieh district of the North Governorate. Situated in the high eastern mountains at an altitude of approximately 1100m.
ABOUT.ETYMOLOGY_DESC: The name Kafar Banin comes from Syriac, meaning 'Village of the Building'. It is often mispronounced as 'Kfardemin', but the correct name is 'Kafar Banin'.
ABOUT.LOCATION_DESC: Bordered by Sfira and Beit Hawik to the west, Al-Qurnat as-Sawda to the east, and Jayroun to the north. It is 37km from Tripoli and 112km from Beirut.
ABOUT.DEMOGRAPHICS_DESC: Home to about 3000 residents. The village boasts a high level of education with many doctors, engineers, and professors.
ABOUT.ECONOMY_DESC: Agriculture is the main source of income, producing annually about 150 tons of apples, 120 tons of peaches, and 70 tons of pears.
ABOUT.INFRASTRUCTURE_DESC: The village has 4 mosques, 2 schools, and a modern municipal building. It draws irrigation water from Nabaa Al-Sukkar and Nabaa Brisa.
ABOUT.LMT_DESC: Kafar Banin is a vital point on the Lebanon Mountain Trail (LMT). It is specifically located within Section 3 (Qammamine to Kafar Banin) and Section 4 (Bqaa Safrine to Kafar Banin).
ABOUT.LMT_LINK: Discover more about the Kafar Banin path
ABOUT.HIDDEN_GEM: Did you know? Kafar Banin is home to the largest Juniper forest in the Middle East!

BET_EL_SULTAN.TITLE: Bet El Sultan
BET_EL_SULTAN.SLOGAN: Your chance to create special memories
BET_EL_SULTAN.DESC: Bet El Sultan is a heritage house in the heart of nature in Kafar Banin, Dannieh. It offers overnight stays, traditional local breakfast, a kids' play area, hiking trails, and a simple farm for agricultural activities.
BET_EL_SULTAN.DETAILS: Located in a serene spot, it perfectly combines traditional Lebanese architecture with modern hospitality, making it a perfect getaway for families and nature lovers.

DHUR_MASH.TITLE: Dhur Mash
DHUR_MASH.SLOGAN: seasonal guesthouse nestled in the heart of nature built with care, created for those who are looking for calm, fresh air, and a quiet escape from city noise.
DHUR_MASH.DESC: The project includes three private units: Two rooms for two guests, and one larger room that accommodates up to four people. Each unit has its own kitchenette, private bathroom, and a balcony overlooking the surrounding greenery.
DHUR_MASH.DETAILS:
Guests can enjoy shared outdoor spaces, a common outdoor kitchen for cooking or barbecuing, Wi-Fi access, and hot water.
What makes Dhur Mash even more special is its garden. The property is surrounded by apple trees, walnut trees, pine trees, apricot trees, and seasonal fresh vegetables. Depending on the season, guests can enjoy the colors, scents, and simple beauty of a living, growing garden.

BLUE_HOUSE.TITLE: Blue House
BLUE_HOUSE.SLOGAN: A cozy guesthouse with a touch of tradition
BLUE_HOUSE.DESC: The Blue House is a charming guesthouse that offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere. It features traditional Lebanese architecture, comfortable rooms.
BLUE_HOUSE.DETAILS: A beautiful traditional stone house nestled among lush greenery and seasonal fruit trees, offering tranquility, fresh mountain air, and an authentic countryside experience.

LAZAB.TITLE: Lazab Forest
LAZAB.DESC: A panoramic lookout offering stunning views of the Dannieh mountains and the sea, especially at sunset.
LAZAB.DETAILS: You can see the coast on clear days along with the refreshing mountain breeze.

MOSQUE.TITLE: Old Stone Mosque
MOSQUE.SLOGAN: The scent of history and spiritual serenity
MOSQUE.DESC: A beautiful example of traditional architecture, this mosque stands as a testament to the village's spiritual heritage.
MOSQUE.DETAILS: Built with hand-carved local stones, the mosque features arched windows and thick walls that keep it cool in summer and warm in winter.
